name: Efficient Pruning Score
definition: An efficient pruning score that reparameterizes the Hessian to use the 2D projected value $g_i$ instead of 3D parameters, reducing storage and enabling training-time pruning.
summary: The Efficient Pruning Score is a sensitivity-based metric that identifies redundant 3D Gaussian primitives by reparameterizing the score to depend on scalar projected values, reducing storage requirements by 36 times compared to the original PUP method.
